sources.role: Iran official Baghaei statements on blockade, loading speculation, conditional opening of Hormuz

Kpler estimates oil flows through Hormuz around 9.5m barrels/day in ten days through Nov19 versus October average 12.2m bpd; distinct dates/period lengths. IEA-based estimated disruption and inventory context are separate upstream estimates.
Monday intraday oil price context, Libya Sharara pipeline resumption and weekend tanker/Houthi claims. Do not convert intraday benchmark to fixed settlement.
Houthi claimed direct hit against Petro Rabigh; no proof Saudi facility damage or closure. Do not count Houthi assertion as verified strike outcome.

Iran-related tanker-loaded movements, UANI tracked no successful Iran-crude export tanker passing blockade after July12; around 12 smaller LPG tankers crossed. OLYM→HAO FAN approx 200,000 barrel STS on Nov17, not independently proof of blockade departure.
A purported Khat Shekan physical tanker's AIS positions were spoofed according to TankerTrackers satellite and identity checks. Specialist source is carried, not independently replicated.
Iranian official says Qatari delegation visited Tehran Nov20 for diplomacy. Meeting not synonymous with bilateral U.S./Iran deal or sanctions relief.
Sunday Gulf share market index moves; exchange-local close timestamps, index definitions and comparative baseline must be checked before charts.
UKMTO warning 216-26 incident near Khasab Oman Nov21 0550 UTC; identity, source warning and unique event dedup need qualification before ship hull loss/track count.
November20 Treasury four trustee designations; separate legal action, original allegation and measured actual revenue outcomes.
U.S. Treasury Nov20 official release; primary legal designation, no independently measured fiscal impact.

referrals.statement: Iran Foreign Ministry's Esmaeil Baghaei says Iran will use available means against U.S. blockade, describes reported oil loading speculation, conditions reopening on relief and other terms. Qatari contacts are separate from a signed deal.
